title: Underground torture/weapon museum
content: This location has appeared in four of my dreams now, so I thought I'd mention it and see if it sounds familiar to anyone. In all cases, I am in dark tunnels underground, sometimes scared by the location and sometimes just curious. Every time there are no lights and I have to use a torch or phone to see, and then I come to a lit archway and enter an underground brick room lit by bar lights. Inside the room are suits of armour, weapons in cases, surgical instruments in cases, and torture devices. Sometimes there is also weird gym equipment or models of war horses. These are particularly notable to me as I rarely see any instruments to do with war or harming others in dreams. On the last occasion there were weird paintings of demons or monsters, and table displays to make sherbert and gems.
